transcript: So we've got a new LG SoundSuite surround system, but it's completely modular and this soundbar system is actually the first to support what's called Dolby Atmos FlexConnect, allowing you to add and subtract speakers to get a surround sound experience if you choose or a stereo experience if you prefer. Everything connects through it and it's actually the world's first soundbar audio system powered by dafc so this is what gives you that capability to have a surround sound experience without having the perfect room or the most optimal environment, it's going to be able to determine where these speakers are in space and then allow them to perform and deliver the right signal given their location. And another part of that is the sound follow feature, which is inside of the app. This allows you to change your physical location within the sound to create an optimal listening experience dependent upon where you happen to sit the room. Now it's important to also note that you can switch between DAFC and stereo. So in a setup like this, it can be the best of both worlds. The front two speakers operating in stereo or having the entire system work together in DAFC itself.
